## 2

I understand why some images can seem easy to fake, but the evidence for a round Earth comes from many independent sources, not just photographs. Ships disappear over the horizon from the bottom up, different stars are visible at different latitudes, Earth’s shadow is round during lunar eclipses, and satellites, GPS, and global communication systems depend on its shape. These observations come from people and organizations around the world, including groups that do not cooperate with one another. Together, they strongly confirm that Earth is roughly spherical.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules in the air. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more easily than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky.

Violet light scatters even more, but our eyes are less sensitive to it, and some violet light is absorbed higher in the atmosphere. That is why the sky usually looks blue rather than violet. At sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere. Much of the blue light gets scattered away, leaving more red, orange, and pink light for us to see.

雨下了一整夜，城市像被一层半透明的纱罩住。昏黄的路灯映在积水里，随着雨点落下，碎成一圈圈晃动的光。屋檐不断滴水，发出细密而有节奏的声响。远处偶尔驶过一辆汽车，轮胎划开水面，短暂地溅起银白色的浪花。窗边的玻璃蒙着雾气，我捧着热茶坐在灯下，听雨声填满房间。夜色安静而漫长，仿佛整个世界都暂时停了下来，只剩下雨在黑暗中低声诉说。
